text:
Marta: Heads-up  prepping an onboarding econ debrief for Acme. Need a short spend snapshot (token econ + onboarding costs) to drop into the renewal packet. Can someone run a model-level spend forecast and highlight spikes? cc @Devon @Kevin

Devon: On it. I can pull last 90d per-model token usage and per-route breakdown. Quick Q: include Dedicated/private infra costs or keep hosted-only?

Marta: Include both. The renewal asks need full picture (hosted vs Dedicated vs burst). Also flag any one-off onboarding bursts.

Kevin: Do we have a one-page template to present conservative/expected/upside forecasts? I can map to pricing levers (credits, throttles, commit).

Marta: Template outline: "avg tokens/day", "7-day peak", "expected growth (30/90d)", "quantization opportunities", "burst protection costs" and a short recommendations box. Keep it <1 page.

Sara: FYI billing-bot created an invoice alert for ACME last night  strange embed batch + Dedicated burst. Link: https://billing.example/alert/ACME-4321

billing-bot: Invoice alert created for account ACME-4321: unusual embed batch + Dedicated burst. Preliminary estimate: $12.4k.

Devon: That spike matches an onboarding embed job we ran. I'll pull request IDs, sample payloads, and the time windows. Sending logs in next message.

Marta: Action items:
1) Devon  spend breakdown + logs by model (due EOD today)
2) Kevin  draft renewal appendix with three pricing levers and example math
3) Sara  confirm alert thresholds and recommend guardrails for onboarding jobs
4) All  review asynchronously before Tom's meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT

Kevin: Quick decision needed: propose preemptive credits or throttling? Product prefers credits to reduce friction during ramp. I can show cost delta both ways.

Marta: Start with credits in appendix, show throttling as alternative with UX tradeoffs. Add a tiny how-to for enablement. :+1:

Devon: Query I'll run to get baseline:
```
SELECT model, sum(tokens) AS tokens, count(*) AS calls
FROM request_logs
WHERE account_id='acme-4321' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Will attach CSV.

Sara: I'll set an interim alert at 60% of the forecast and create an "onboarding" flag so alerts ignore expected migration bursts once we sign off.

Kevin: Drafting appendix now. Expect first pass in ~3 hours and will ping here for review. :thumbsup:

Marta: Also capture any customer feedback about quality regressions  if the team saw drops after quantization or model swaps, include eval diffs/links.

Devon: Noted. There was a subtle chat-quality regression with the quantized variant in last deploy; I'll include eval diffs and a quick remediation note.

Marta: Great. If anything blocks, escalate to @lead-cs. I'll consolidate and ship the packet by COB. :robot_face:
